newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Trygg-Hansa, Skandia shares rise on bond market.
newsitem.headline: Trygg-Hansa, Skandia shares rise on bond market.

text.p: Shares in Swedish insurers Trygg-Hansa and Skandia rebounded on Friday, supported by a stronger bond market.

At 1235 GMT, Trygg-Hansa was up 5.8 percent, or eight crowns, at 146 and Skandia traded 2.6 percent, or 5.5 crowns, higher at 220.5. Meanwhile, the exchange's general index was up 1.10 percent at 2,656.65.
By Thursday's close Trygg-Hansa had fallen 18 crowns this week, while Skandia had dropped 26.
"Skandia and Trygg-Hansa are very interest rate sensitive and have lost much earlier in the week," a trader said.
"This is just a rebound now when interest rates have come down a couple of basis points. The same scenario has affected other Nordic insurance companies."
